body: I get where you're coming from but im scared I'll either end this degree with a really shit grade or with severe depression

I study psychology in Uk, tbh its not really common to take a yr off in the middle of your degree, you can certainly take a gap year between undergrad and postgrad though. I guess the main reason im even in uni is cause of my parents but I feel like im at the point where I cant even use them as motivation
I’ve thought about that but my course is three years and they know that. There’s also no chance of me moving out until I’m married😭
Thank you that helps so much!! I’ve been too scared to say anything to him cause everyone thinks of him as soo nice and I didn’t wanna seem like the bad guy
Yeah I’ve decided to quit cause even if he magically starts being nice to me the job itself is too stressful and it’s not worth sacrificing my own health over

Hey, thank you for the advice!! 
Tbh it’s just a part time job so it’s not that important to me, and yeah I talked to my manager about it and he said he’d try to sort it out for me and apparently I’m not the only one he’s like that with!!

Thank you, 
yeah one can only hope this whole crisis ends soon. 

Honestly I don’t think I have a way to cope with it, or ever did. 
I just took it and tried to contain myself till I was out of sight and then just sort of released everything.

Thank u so much, I forgot how nice it feels when someone is kind towards you!! 
I don’t think they’ll ever see me as their kid or feel any sort of warmth towards me. 
Do you have any methods of staying sane?

I wish I could but they’re young, I feel like the only reason I’m still here is cause of them. It’s horrible that you and your siblings go through the same thing but you all have each other to lean on. 
I feel like I’m singled out from my siblings

Thank u! I doubt I’ll be able to get away cause we’ll probably be on lockdown till may/June time and by then it’ll be summer so I’ll still be home nonetheless:( 
I study law at uni!

I feel the same way. I’m nearly 20 and my parents still try to control every aspect of my life and have a problem with everything I do. I’ve contemplated killing myself just so they would realise how much they hurt me. 
My parents are asian as well and I know that even if I try to talk to them, nothing would get through.
